title: FlowBudget: Training-Free Sampling-Budget Estimation for Flow Matching Models
summary: The authors introduce FlowBudget, a training-free estimator designed to determine the solver-relative sampling complexity and numerical resolution required for flow matching models without relying on empirical Fréchet Inception Distance (FID) sweeps. title: Expanding Attention: A Taylor-Series Route to Linear-Time Transformers with a Fixed Number of Recurrent States

title: Same Answer, New Box: How Much of RLVR's Out-of-Domain Gain Is Answer Format?

title: Do Vision CIL Methods Transfer to Protein? A Diagnostic Benchmark of Frozen Protein Encoders
summary: This research evaluates nine representative class-incremental learning methods across five protein encoders and two enzyme function datasets to test their transferability from computer vision.
